# UI text baseline fixtures

Historical LANG-003 comparison data, described in [the baseline](../../../docs/UI_TEXT_BASELINE.md). These files are not runtime catalogue data, fallback strings, an active independent contract or evidence of executed Rust/GUI/VM behaviour.

- `mapping.json` maps every frozen inventory candidate/retained occurrence to its display keys or retention reason. Keep original source literals/lines/hashes. `source_bindings` captures Rust formatting specs; `parameters` defines the named typed display inputs. `variants` lists the real keys for optional notes/save failures; its base `key` is a branch family. `fixed_worker_alias` retains the wire input while comparing the already selected friendly GUI alias. Supplementary labels separate resource/stage presentation from protocol identities.
- `outputs.json` records source-derived expected output strings and hashes. Cases labelled `source_template` use prepared safe synthetic binding values and may be before the error-dialog host, not final shown error summaries. Selected assembled review/history and reporting/CLI cases state their boundary/selectors. `source_prepared_inputs`, when present, includes an original empty optional sentinel; `inputs` contains only the parameters of the selected new key. Numeric/unit prepared values must retain the original code-owned arithmetic/format spec.
- `control-contract.json` records required semantic regressions and expected decisions/model behaviour under deliberately edited copy. The edits are test stimuli, not proposed product wording. No case is marked as an executed pass.
- `revised-fixed.json` records the deliberate recovery-hold and preliminary-review wording changes from the October 2026 QA fixes. Fixed binding tests use these expectations for those two keys while preserving the original mapping.

Migration tests compare decoded UTF-8 output bytes without trimming, Unicode normalization, recursive placeholder evaluation or unit conversion. Check final key coverage separately from consumer reachability, branch coverage, redaction and runtime effects. Binding-only examples are not valid/admitted VM plans.

Preserve the historical extraction baseline after deliberate editorial changes. Add revised expectations for approved wording separately, and retain semantic tests independent of display strings. No target identities, credential material, native output, actual driver payload or machine-specific results are recorded here; all inputs are synthetic.
